programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.(n)

programme.title: 李錦記 餐餐陪住您 呈獻：炙熱遊戲：百廚大戰
programme.sub-title: 交鋒進入白熱化 岳雲鵬直呼要命
programme.desc: 以「中國食材」為題，匯集近百位廚師，分為聲名顯赫的「星級廚師」以及風格迥異的「民間廚師」兩大陣營，釋出渾身解數，通過多重廚藝關卡比拼廚技，與潘瑋柏、岳雲鵬、劉濤、孟佳等炙熱評審共同見證「年度廚王」的誕生.(n)

programme.title: 亞洲新聲
programme.sub-title: 可樓芳美芝拿捏蘇有朋
programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演.(n)

programme.title: 新相親時代
programme.desc: 全新相親交友節目，男女嘉賓帶著父母一起登台相親，全家上陣尋覓姻緣，展現兩代人婚戀觀的碰撞.(n)

programme.title: 金曲撈之挑戰主打歌 第2季
programme.desc: 每集由一位原唱歌手對抗三位金曲守護人，以自己的非主打歌與主打歌同台PK，通過現場500位大眾聽審的投票決定挑戰是否成功。原唱歌手包括任賢齊、鄭少秋、吳克群、周筆暢、鄧紫棋、李克勤、趙傳、蔡健雅、許美靜、許茹芸等.(n)

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第2季
programme.desc: 延續了上一季的基本模式，尋找一群30+都市輕熟齡男女入住 “半熟公寓”，在經歷一個月的單身公寓合租生活後，他們互相了解，走進了彼此的朋友圈、工作圈、生活圈，呈現不同的社交關係與情感發展，與陳妍希、杜海濤、喬欣、吳昕、王子文等「半熟觀察員」一起見證愛情的發生.(n)

programme.title: 煥新環遊傳
programme.sub-title: 藍盈瑩九郎體驗畬族婚禮
programme.desc: 蔡少芬、陶昕然、斕曦、張曉龍、藍盈瑩、陳思斯、楊九郎時隔13年後首次合體重聚，以全新的面貌組成「煥新團」，從承載無數記憶的《甄嬛傳》拍攝地北京大觀園出發，自北向南，由東向西，前往全國多個寶藏民族文化發源地，通過深度探訪、遊學，體驗各地民俗文化和風土人情，帶著回憶和新的憧憬環遊全國以完成“煥新之旅”.(n)

programme.title: 音浪合夥人
programme.desc: 蘇有朋、薛之謙、王嘉爾、周筆暢、胡彥斌、歐陽娜娜等明星作為音浪召集人，他們將與300位合夥人組成3組音浪團，在24小時內緊急排練，一起完成創意十足的音樂SHOW.(n)

programme.desc: After witnessing his parents' death, billionaire Bruce Wayne learns the art of fighting to confront injustice. When he returns to Gotham as Batman, he must stop a secret society that intends to destroy the city.(n)

programme.title: 天地大冲撞
programme.desc: A comet is discovered to be on a collision course with Earth. As doomsday nears, the human race prepares for the worst.(n)

programme.title: 猛鬼3寶
programme.desc: This anthology film features a triplet of horror stories starring up-and-coming actors and popular local Youtubers. When a film crew is haunted by paranormal activities, the director decides to cast her to play a ghost; When a taxi driver takes his girlfriend to a party room to get it on, a horny ghost adds spice to the proceedings; When a wandering ghost refuses to leave a soon-to-be-gentrified mall, the tenants concoct a plan to send her off.

programme.title: 老豆死開一陣先
programme.desc: Angst-ridden college student, Nanase Nobata (Suzu Hirose), lives with her father, Hakaru, president of the Nobata Pharmaceutical Company, resentful of his constant nagging about her life, and for being so absorbed in his work. While developing a revolutionary 'reverse aging' drug, Hakaru's team discovered a drug that causes temporary death, followed by full recovery in 2 days. Hakaru had been persuaded to take the drug in an attempt to expose a corporate spy planted in his company by a rival firm looking to merge with Nobata and capitalize on the anti-aging formula. When Hakaru drops dead, it sets the company in an uproar as his will names Nanase as the new president. She soon learns the truth about her father's condition and the spy from Matsuoka (Ryo Yoshizawa), a young employee in the company. Together with Matsuoka and the actual ghost of Hakaru, Nanase endeavors to prevent her father's enemies from prematurely cremating his body before the drug can wear off and allow him.

programme.title: 蕩寇風雲
programme.desc: During the 16th century, Japanese pirates proliferate along the Chinese coastline. In 1557, the pirates take over Cengang in Zhejiang. After months of futile advances, Commander Yu finally defeats them under the leadership of newly promoted General Qi. The pirates, however, manage to escape. No sooner has Qi identified the key weakness of the Chinese army than he starts remapping the coastal regions to eradicate the pirates. When he finds the villagers of Yiwu loyal and courageous, he drafts them into his own army which soon becomes a formidable force against the pirates, with tactics developed specifically against them. In 1561, the pirates regroup and once again attack the coastal cities of China. With both the cities of Xinhe and Taizhou under attack, Qi's army is caught between two fires. Even though most family members of his soldiers are located in Xinhe, Qi makes the tough decision to go to Taizhou and leaves his wife in charge of the fight against the pirates in Xinhe.

programme.title: 得寵先生
programme.desc: Yam Chun Kai, is a 60-year-old curmudgeon living alone. Forced into retirement, Uncle Kai reflects on his failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter. As the hopelessness prompts him to end his life, a stray dog named Roast Piggy finds Uncle Kai and leads an animal welfare volunteer, Una Tang, to rescue him-the intelligence and humanity of Roast Piggy change Uncle Kai's attitude towards stray animals. Uncle Kai becomes friends with Una and joins her animal shelter 'Warm Home' as a volunteer, helping the abandoned animals. Una hopes Uncle Kai can take this opportunity to clear the air between him and his daughter Zoie. Just as Uncle Kai's life seems to be getting back on track, several dog poisoning incidents occur in the village he lives in..

programme.title: 藍色巨星
programme.desc: Miyamoto Dai, a student with a passion for basketball, has an overnight life-changing experience after going to a jazz show for the first time. As if hypnotised by this music he knows nothing about, the young man decides to devote himself heart and soul to the saxophone and jazz becomes his new passion. Will he succeed in becoming a great musician.

programme.title: 寒戰2
programme.desc: The story of this highly-anticipated sequel continues as Acting Police Commissioner Sean Lau (Aaron Kwok) is promoted to the highest rank in the police force. Joe (Eddie Peng Yuyan), son of Deputy Police Commissioner Waise Lee (Tony Leung Ka Fai) who is behind the conspiracy, is taken into custody and Waise is forced to retire. But Master, Themind remains unknown, until the resurface of a former police chief who unveils an unprecedented scheme to corrupt the police force. Things get more complicated when senior counsel Oswald Kan (Chow Yun Fat) leads an impeachment proceeding against Sean. Oswald's every decision is pivotal in determining who stays on top of the game.

programme.title: 沒有美色殺人狂
programme.desc: 'Do we lacking anything? We have a house, a truck, and very attractive.' Self-proclaimed tough guy Jae-pil and sexy guy Sang-gu leave an unforgettable first impression on their moving day. Despite becoming special surveillance targets for Police Chief Choi and Officer Nam, they are simply happy to start anew in their European-style dream house. However, happiness is short-lived as they are inadvertently mistaken for kidnappers while trying to rescue Mina, who almost drowns. Meanwhile, uninvited guests looking for Mina start appearing, and an ancient spirit sealed in the basement awakens, surrounding the house with dark energy.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 愛慾難分: 抱抱俏佳人
programme.desc: One night, wedding planner - Yan met a young attorney, Fun and had a one-night stand. Later, Fung did accidentally join to Yan's wedding planning company. In a special wedding, regardless of Yan against Fung, the rigid procedures of the wedding ceremony turned into a warm, touching the carnival. Customers in more than touched, the two are deeply moved a step closer so emotional. However, the emotional harm suffered psychological Yan still cannot break the shackles of courage in the face of her girlfriends Fung's hand holding a bold recognition of this relationship. At this time, her fiance - Kelvin was again disrupted Yan's emotional world. Who is her true Love....

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 鬼請你睇戲
programme.desc: GV Broadway Cinema is the oldest cinema in the city and it'll be demolished soon. The cinema has always been dark and cold, so it became the last place for the ghost to stay. Yang Yang found a temporary job in the cinema. But this is the last day of his job, so he brings his girlfriend Yiu-yiu to watch the last movie, not realizing a horrible nightmare is coming..

programme.title: 窄路微塵
programme.desc: Under this flashy city, amidst the numbness of frustrations, what people are looking forward to is the glimmer of light that might change their lives. Chak, who runs a small cleaning company, barely takes over the cleaning work on his own to make a living. Hitting by the COVID-19 pandemic, small business closed down one by one. One day, a young single mother, Candy, comes to look for a job opportunity from Chak. She doesn't seem like a trustworthy person to Chak, unexpectedly, she helps Chak to resolve many difficulties at work. Life seems like get back on track. The morning sun never lasts a day, Chak's company is being accused, at the same time, his family is facing a nightmare as well, all his hopes are dashed to pieces, but they can still try their best to resist the oppression of life and support each other through this painful year.

programme.title: 金雞
programme.desc: It is an exploration of one woman's wacky life of prostitution, spanning over 20 years in Hong Kong. Unattractive but happy-go-lucky and spunky, KUM is a true Hong Kong survivor.

programme.title: 天下無賊
programme.desc: Bo and Li are perfect crime couple crime, until Li decides to quit. It is at the crossroad in their lives and relationships. When they run into Fu Gen, their fate is altered..

programme.title: 蠟筆小新：瞓啦！早唞早著夢作戰
programme.desc: During his sleep, Shinchan enters a fantasy world where he could find all his favorite things, starting from chocolates, cakes and young beautiful girls. But it soon turns out to be a nightmare world where Shinchan, his friends and family get trapped and are unable to escape. They've also met a mysterious girl named Saki who is somehow connected to these dreams. Now it is up to Shinchan and the Kasukabe Defence Group to save their dreams and escape from the nightmare world.

programme.title: 給自己的情歌
programme.desc: Suddenly learning she is terminally ill, 'Se-yeon' asks her husband, 'Jin-bong', the absurd task of helping her find her first love, and he unwillingly joins her search. Along their journey, 'Se-yeon' and 'Jin-bong' are reminded of the most glittering, beautiful moments of their lives.

programme.title: 追捕
programme.desc: Manhunt follows the journey of upstanding lawyer Du Qiu, who is unwittingly drawn into a murder case when all the evidence at the scene points to him being the perpetrator. Knowing that he's been framed by Luo Zhi, Du Qiu runs from the law to uncover the truth. The police launch a large-scale manhunt, but veteran detective Yamura sees that this seemingly open-and-shut case is not that simple after all. During the intense pursuit, a bond begins to build between the fugitive and his pursuer, even though Yamura knows that he can't fully trust Du Qiu. Is the real killer lurking elsewhere? Is there a hidden conspiracy behind the murder.

programme.title: 繼續爭氣
programme.desc: In 2013, My Voice, My Life followed classes of students from three high schools for underprivileged kids and one school for the visually impaired as they embarked on a voyage of self-discovery through taking part in a musical production. Six years later, what kinds of lives are they leading now? My Voice, My Life Revisited goes in search of four of those students: Ah Bok, Coby, Sio Fan and Tsz Nok, charting their transformation and how they have grown over these past few years, as well as the challenges they are facing today.

programme.title: 華麗上班族
programme.desc: Billion-dollar Company Jones & Sunn is going public. Chairman Ho Chung-ping (Chow Yun Fat) has promised CEO Chang (Sylvia Chang), who has been his mistress for more than twenty years, to become a major shareholder of the company. As the IPO team enters the company to audit its accounts, a series of inside stories start to be revealed. Lee Xiang (Wang Ziyi), a new hire at Jones & Sunn, brings with him youthful ideals and dreams. Within the neoliberal market, the logic of intrigue rules, complicated by entanglements of love-hate relationships, which weaves a power play and a pathos-laden tragedy inside the office.

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王
programme.desc: Mysterious events keep happening in Luoyang: warriors wearing totem masks perpetrate crime all around the city; the fox outside the bar begins to speak human language; dragons on the column of the palace come alive; the Heavenly Kings in the temple show its angry face. Dee needs to solve the puzzles behind the mysterious cases, while facing obstacles from Empress Wu.

programme.title: 六樓后座
programme.desc: Six twentysomethings from their own worlds converge at a bargain apartment affordable by one but perfect for six. With a goal to reach, a deal they make, and a year to complete, they 'fulfill' them with indulging pleasures and, endless games of truth or dare, and madness nourishing the 6th Floor Rear Flat. Sweet Dreams die well when the 12-month lease ends come an unwelcome reminder, the lost souls wake with frightening awareness to the touchline once they think never impossible. Between being responsible and getting away, is youth still a mighty weapon for failures.

programme.title: 販賣．愛
programme.desc: Due to financial needs, undergraduate Tiffany took up compensated dating, regarding it as a personal choice that has nothing to do with ethics. Though at first, she's feeling a bit uneasy, but soon she became indifferent. After one unpleasant experience serving a group of Japanese clients, she wanted to quit. But her agent Hazelnut convinced her to take up a long-term sponsor Cheung. In the course of serving Cheung, a subtle feeling nourished between the two. On the other hand, she came across Rex, a young guy of integrity and passion. After one incident, she decided to quit Cheung and took up a new life with Rex. But just when she thought she could start over anew, something unexpected turned up making her realized that she had to pay for what she had chosen before..(c)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(c)

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -逃出大風鎮
programme.desc: In the film “Trapped”, border town Mangya was taken over by a group of bandits where only three police officers with one pistol stationed. How could they bring all 44 bandits to justice? First-time director Zhang Qi reveals the inspirations and ideas behind in particular the story of notorious four criminals from the Mainland and Hong Kong's “King of Robbery” Yip Kai Foon while also tells more about his creative motive for several scenes of violence on screen.(c)

programme.title: 愛慾難分: 流浪之月
programme.desc: In a park on a rainy evening, a 19-year-old university student, Fumi, offers an umbrella to a soaking wet 10-year-old girl, Sarasa. Realizing her reluctance to go home, Fumi lets her stay in his place, where she spends the next two months in peace. They take each other's hands and seem to have finally found their place in the world until Fumi is arrested for kidnapping. Fifteen years later, the lonely two are reunited both still suffering from the stigma as the victim and perpetrator of “a pedophile case”. Will the society give a place to their unshakable bond they have formed.(c)

programme.title: 我的情敵女婿
programme.desc: An ageing bachelor playboy finally meets the girl of his dreams and proposes marriage, only to discover her psychologist stepmom was his first love long ago. The future in-laws initially pretend not to know each other but as the wedding date gets nearer, the rekindling of long-dormant feelings develops into a cross-generational love triangle.(n)

programme.title: 心裏美
programme.desc: Mr. K.K. Ho, is a leading “star tutor” with remarkable achievements. Lee Lung Kei , the stingy boss and principal of the cram school, regards Mr. Ho as a trump card. Chloe, a traditional high school teacher, has always tried her best in teaching. Chloe despises K.K.'s teaching methods and refers to them as deviant. The two of them give tit for tat in class. Their conflict leads to K.K.'s appreciation for Chloe. He gives her flowers as an apology, but Chloe never accepts. He finds out Chloe is the daughter of Principal Lee. When she was young, she witnessed her mother being bullied and died by accident. That is why she deeply hates her father and refuses to get in touch with him. K.K. with wisdom and courage, who breaks through all the obstacles to pursue Chloe but also takes into account the father-daughter relationship. However, he learns Chloe has genetic heart disease and what's worse, due to her diligent teaching for years, the doctor believes that she could only live for.(n)

programme.title: 第一誡
programme.desc: Every day, the Police Force receives 185 phone calls.180 of them are about burglaries, murders, rapes and kidnappings. The remaining 5 begin with: “There is something strange in my house, can you please send someone over to take a look?” For rookie Sergeant Lee, being a cop means running down crooks and upholding the law. Despondent, Adam has a drunken tryst with his student, Mandy. Adam gains new insight after accidentally discovering Eva's private journal. Entitled '77 Heartbreaks', the title refers to the philosophy that 'forgiving someone 7 times isn't enough; 70 x 7 times is too much; so go ahead and forgive 77 times!' programme.desc: Searching for true love in this prejudiced world. Jae-hee is a free-spirited girl who often becomes the center of rumors, while her classmate Heung-soo struggles to hide his true identity. One night at the bar district, Jae-hee discovers the other side of Heung-soo that no one else knows and helps him keep it a secret in public. As Heung-soo accidentally becomes Jae-hee's roommate, they realize that despite not being each other's ideal types, their companionship fosters a deep and strong friendship. Together, they navigate life's unexpected challenges and rely on each other like family as they courageously pursue their own paths in love and life.(n)

programme.title: 銀魂 THE FINAL
programme.desc: Counting down to the destruction of the earth, Gintoki, Takasugi, Katsura are shuttling across places with clashing thoughts. However, there is someone who has sorrowful connections with them, standing in the way...... ‘Utsuro', who has a different personality from Shoyo Yoshida, the greatly respected teacher who guided the way of Gintoki's clan. To help Gintoki's clan, Shinpachi, Kagura, Shinsengumi, residents in Kabuki district and even old rivals are taking part in the battle! The gradually self-multiplying Utsuro's power, Takasugi is betting his own life to confront. The final scenery which black-and-blue Gintoki would see is...! Will Gintoki be able to claim all the things back..(n)

programme.title: 看不見的證人
programme.desc: After a car accident, a blind girl named Thu reports to the police about the incident that she believes to be fatal. However, because she is blind, she encounters difficulties in persuading the police to believe her. At the same time, Hai, another witness of the incident, suddenly appears with conflicting testimonies about the crime scene. While the police is having a headache verifying whose information was true, the killer secretly follows both Thu and Hai to kill the witnesses.(n)

programme.title: 公寓裡的兩個女人
programme.desc: Yi-jung lives with her mother Su-kyung, but they do not get along well with each other. While out grocery shopping one day, they fight as usual and Su-kyung's car ends up hitting Yi-jung in the parking lot. Yi-jung does not believe Su-kyung's claim that the car suddenly accelerated on its own and thinks her mother hit her on purpose. Now, Yi-jung wants an apology from Su-kyung for everything that happened in her life.(n)

programme.title: 陳可辛光影武俠
programme.desc: Wu Xia' picked up 12 nominations and 2 awards for the 31st Hong Kong Film Awards. In this exclusive Interview, Director Peter Ho-sun Chan talks about this martial arts action film.(n)

programme.title: 武俠
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi lives a seemingly normal life in a remote village. But his peaceful life is soon to be disrupted when a determined detective digs up his past.(n)

programme.title: 瘦身男女
programme.desc: Mini Mo becomes an fatty when her boyfriend went abroad ten years ago. She meets Fatso in the time of adversity. When Fatso learns the true story behind Mini's depression..(n)

programme.title: 男人四十
programme.desc: Secondary school teacher Lam Yiu-kwok is suffering from a mid-life crisis - his peers have all become more successful than him; his relationship with his wife, Chan Man-ching, is in trouble when her old flame returns, and he finds himself tempted by a 17-year-old student who has a crush on him..(n)

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.(n)

programme.title: 體驗撈金魚吧
programme.desc: Makoto Kashiba is angry and depressed after losing his job as an elite banker and being sent to the countryside. By chance (Or is it fate?) he meets a beautiful girl, Kitsuno. However, the man she's in love with is master pianist and goldfish catcher, Noboru Oji. Bonds between them form, and a love triangle begins..(n)

programme.title: 西遊記之孫悟空三打白骨精
programme.desc: 500 years after the havoc in heaven, Xuanzang, the Tang Priest, is appointed by the Buddha to go to the West to fetch the Buddhist scriptures. By accident, Xuangzang undoes the Buddha's spell on Sun Wukong, the Monkey King. Wukong brought under control by a gold hoop given by the Mercy Goddess. He has no choice but to accept the mission to escort Xuanzang to the West. Despite his reluctance. Wukong cuts paths all the way and dutifully helps to subdue Bajie and Sha. But the hoop on this head, effective with his master's restrictive incantation, always remains a vexation for Wukong. Lady White Bone Spirit from the White Tiger Ridge aims to kill and eat Xuanzang's golden body for evading her doom of reincarnation from a demon to any other creature. After dealing with the four, White Bone Spirit has an insight into the barrier between Wukong and Xuanzang. So, she designs traps to foment discord between them. Humiliated mistakenly, Wukong still fights on with both strength and wit.(n)

programme.title: 大佬愛美麗
programme.desc: Georgie's dad, Hung, was a Triad leader. After Hung's death, his right-hand Cheung intends to bring back Georgie to take over. But Cheung finds Sam, whom he mistakes for Georgie..(n)

programme.title: 男航女機師
programme.desc: HAN Jung-woo, a pilot with top-class skills, is flying high and even appears on a famous TV show. But everything comes crashing down when a careless mistake causes him to lose everything, even his job. Blacklisted in the industry, no airline is willing to hire him. Desperate with no other choice, HAN Jung-woo transforms completely into his younger sister's identity and succeeds in landing a job as a pilot. But soon, he encounters more unexpected problems... Will his dream of cruising through life ever take off.(n)

programme.title: 七劍
programme.desc: In the early 1660's the Manchurians took over the sovereignty of China and established the Qing Dynasty. With many pro-nationalist revolts occurring, the newly set-up government immediately imposed a ban on the study and practice of the Martial Arts. Fire-wind, a military official from the previous dynasty, ravages and ranges across North-western China with his next goal to attack the final frontier - the intransigent and hold-out town know as the Martial Village. Fu Qinghu, a retired executioner from the previous dynasty, feels a moral obligation to try and put a stop to this brutality and decides to save Martial Village. He convinces two young people from the village to travel with him to Mount Heaven in order to seek help from Master Shadow-Glow, a hermit who is a master of swords and leads a group of disciples with unimaginable swordsmanship..(n)

programme.title: 青龍影后秀: JSA安全地帶
programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight..(n)

programme.title: 師姐大晒
programme.desc: FBI Cindy is ordered to Hong Kong to get the leader of counterfeit banknote manufacturing syndicate, Huang Te. In Hong Kong, Huang goes into the printing business. Ostensibly, he publishes a newspaper. But his real business is still the forgoing of banknotes. Cindy gets a job as the paper's reporter but alert Hong Kong police tell her to keep off. It is their job to get Huang. Cindy happens to know her friend's father is the prosecutor in Huang's trial. She tries to help but Huang gets off by poisoning the prosecutor. Now Cindy is desperate. The police want to see her back in America. She wants to get Huang herself..

programme.title: 求愛夜驚魂
programme.desc: Lung is a handsome young man. He has gift of the gab and is the best company to keep. Jane is a young talented reporter. She is devoted to her job. Lung and Jane seem to be ideally matched. But Jane, the famous TV reporter, has a lawyer boyfriend. And Lung is a mere taxi driver, just one of Jane's admirers. But Lung is determined to try. He gets to know Jane and gives her hot news tips. He organizes his cabbie friends into a radio news network, informing him all the happenings around the town. This works out at first, but sometimes they are led into ridiculous situation. Jane is slowly distancing herself form Lung. In desperation, Lung calls Jane saying he has the news of the century for her..

programme.title: 走進老許記
programme.desc: Look back on 4 comedy classics with 7 top filmmakers of our time. Explore the cultural impact of The Hui Brothers – the most successful cinema trio in Hong Kong history.

programme.title: 賣身契
programme.desc: The contract is a piece of almost blank paper by which MTV binds all its employees to eight years of impecunious service. Chi-Man, an aspiring but frustrated artist, hates the contract since he is given no chance of getting ahead. He constantly thinks of moving to greener pastures. His brother Chi-Ying is a self-made investor who has just come up with a laugh bomb. By chance, Chi-Man becomes the host of a Cat TV program. With the aid of the laugh bomb, he becomes an instant success, yet..

programme.title: 洗黑錢
programme.desc: David is a young lawyer who launders money for a gang leader in Chinatown. He is robbed and his assistant got killed when he carries a large sum of cash to Hong Kong. David turns to Waise, his law school buddy, for help. He doesn't realize that it is Waise who sets up the robbery. Petty, Waise's partner in the law firm, finds out that Waise has conducted some illegal activities. Before she could unveil the truth to the police, Petty is murdered. To cover up the truth, Waise finds Mandy, a promising solicitor, as scapegoat of Petty's death. Waise also sends out a gunman to track down Mandy. In a last minute rescue, Mandy is saved by one of her client, Dragon. She always finds the client obnoxious, but now she has to team up with Dragon to fight back and to prove her innocence at the same time..

programme.title: 開心鬼救開心鬼
programme.desc: Hong Sum Kwai is enjoying a second life in metropolis Hong Kong. His girlfriend, Annie, is oblivious to the fact that her former incarnation was the village girl who perished the General to eternal suffering. Hong Sum Kwai teaches at the school where Annie's father serves as the principal. There are four sprightly yet mischievous male students in Hong Sum Kwai's charge, but they are duped by the girls and left stranded in the wilderness discovering the dead body of the General..

programme.title: 拳王
programme.desc: Silent classmate Ming, an ambitious boxing addict, decides to learn boxing in Thailand after a technical knockdown in a contest which he was confident of winning. By witnessing the rigorous training on the spot, he not only develops the physique of a boxer but enhances the dignity and dauntless spirit of the boxer in a tournament. Tak is another young upcoming boxer. He learned Chinese martial arts from his father since childhood. Not wanting to be cooped up in the narrow confines of boxing only, he undergoes hard training in Thai boxing in a gym, hoping to widen the boxing horizon..

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 師姐好狠勁: 雷霆特警
programme.desc: Zhao libing, an outstanding member of the Hong Kong special police force, was selected to attend special training in Seoul. During the training process, Bing met Li Ziping and Jin Yuqi, and instructor Zhang was very strict with them. After the graduation ceremony, Bing said goodbye to Qi and Ping and Cheng Zhengde sent her to the airport. They were busy with their jobs. Bing cracked a counterfeit banknote case in Hong Kong. One of the prisoners was willing to be a tainted witness and said that the mastermind was in South Korea. Bing accompanied with the Interpol to escort the tainted witness to Seoul..

programme.title: 賭俠大戰拉斯維加斯
programme.desc: The story to after The Conman, where Dragon's sister Ching went to study in Canada. After King and Dragon defeated Macau Mon, they became swindling partners..

programme.desc: Sam and Crab are a pair of skilled gamblers. When Sam chooses to leave the life, Crab engages the vengeful attention of Yakuza. The gangsters strike back by kidnapping Sam's girl..

programme.title: 摩登保鏢
programme.desc: Comedy trio the Hui Brothers' produce and star in this hilarious and off the wall laugh-fest and box-office hit, Security Unlimited. Michael Hui stars as head security guard Chou, whose unorthodox, and at times ridiculous approach to training his subordinates doesn't seem to go down well with his boss, Fan (Stanley Fung). Sam (Sam Hui) and Bruce (Ricky Hui) are Chou's favorite targets of abuse, but Chou soon finds the shoe is on the other foot when Ricky gets promoted after saving the day in a botched bank heist.

programme.title: 奇緣
programme.desc: On the slopes of the Himalayas, in the myth-shrouded land of Nepal, there is tribe of demi-gods. They are blessed with superhuman powers and a wise ruler. The leader, unfortunately, is old and sick. He asks divine guidance to find his successor to protect his tribe against the Messenger of Evil. The chief sends out his beautiful slave girl to find the successor. Young architect Joe of Hong Kong comes to Nepal with his girl friend Ida for a Himalayan safari. The slave girl uses and accident to take Joe to the chief. The chief transfuses his magic powers into Joe and he dies..

programme.title: 猛鬼差館
programme.desc: A Hong Kong police station used to be a clubhouse of the Japanese at the time of their occupation of the city during World War II. However, at the end of the war, many of the Japanese committed haka-kiri in the clubhouse. In the present time, after thief Sneaky Ming was captured and incarcerated at the station, he was lured into a world of the paranormal by the spirits of those still inhabiting the building. He was tricked into unleashing the fierce General Issei, who resurrects into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the city. As a result, police officers Kam Mark-K and Man-Chill attempt to put a stop to the terror.

programme.title: A計劃
programme.desc: This is Hong Kong at the turn of the century. The South China Sea is crawling with smugglers, cut-throats and pirates and none is more successful than the gang led by the notorious pirate Lo. Government forces invariably lose to Lo. Finally the Government looks the other way whenever Lo is around. Young seaman Jackie Chan, so far better known for his bar room fights, resigns from the Marine Force. He plans to stage a personal vendetta against Lo. Jackie gets the help of Samo Hung, little knowing Samo has his own axe to grind. Jackie and Samo suffer an inglorious drubbing in the hands of Lo. Jackie, now completely incensed, decides to don the uniform once again. He finds young commander Yuen Biao sympathetic to his cause but adamant against his antics..

programme.title: 八星報喜
programme.desc: Fai, the eldest, has met Fong. Long is a guy with many girl-friends. A girl working in a deparment store has become his target. Sung, is a timid artist. Ying comes into his life..

programme.title: 呆佬拜壽
programme.desc: Ji Fu, the successor of Ji's family, becomes an idiot after being knocked out in an 'accident' created by the second-successor Ji Jack. After being an idiot, Fu meets Mon Tee..

programme.title: 阿郎的故事
programme.desc: Ah Long is a car racing fanatic who is in love with Ah Kar. Ignoring her mother's advice, Ah Kar decides to marry Ah Long. Tragic follows by this illegal car racing contest..

programme.title: 師姐好狠勁: 皇家女將
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: 鼠膽龍威
programme.desc: Jet Li was a police when he lived in China, owing to his wife and son's death in a case of extort, it made him give up his career as a police and resigned. For a time he disappeared and no one could find him. Jet was eager to find the killer of his wife and son but he was familiar with the killer's voice only. After two year, while Loong Wei a famous action star presented himself on a high risk jump, he actually was as timid as a mouse..

programme.title: 我在黑社會的日子
programme.desc: Hung Hing Family boss Lee Qun was ambushed on his way to Macau. His heir Lee Mun-ho flew back from the States for the funeral. Mun-ho, who did not want to mingle with the mobsters, planned to return to the States for good after wrapping up his father's business in Hong Kong. However, through his intelligence and managerial skills, he turned Hung Hing into a well organized business structure. On the other hand, Yeung Kong, a young and ambitious mobster who was brought up under the old Triad tradition, strongly opposed Mun-ho..(n)

programme.title: 殺手之王
programme.desc: With a box of worthless war bonds, an old man hired the King of Killers to assassinate a Japanese trade lord. In WWII, the trade lord's action had caused grave damage to the family of the King of Killers. He agrees to take the job and delivers in a few days. The Revenge Fund set up by the trade lord kicks in. Whoever avenges the trade lord's death, killing the killer and the force behind him, will receive a reward of $1 billion. The police assigns Inspector to watch the killers, with orders to leave them room when they kill each other. Among the killers vying for the reward are Fu, a new immigrant, and his agent, Wong a longtime loser trying to score a big one riding on Fu's coat-tail. After an elaborately orchestrated chain of events, Wong and Fu manage to accomplish their goal.(n)

programme.title: 陰陽錯
programme.desc: Koo, an insurance investigator, is sent to make enquiries regarding a case of accidental death. He is surprised to learn that the victim is the same ghost who has spoken to him the night before. Koo is fascinated in working on the case. One night, Yu's spirit appeared in Koo's apartment. Her beauty and pleasant personality intrigued Koo. They get involved into a romance between man and a spirit. Will Koo and Yu be reunited or will Yu remain, as always, Koo's esprit d'amour?(n)

programme.title: 警察故事續集
programme.desc: Receiving a humiliating demotion to traffic duty, Chan decides to take a vacation with girlfriend May. However, when terrorists threaten Hong Kong, he abort his vacation plans..(n)

programme.title: 大冒險家
programme.desc: 20 years ago, in the region of Golden Triangle, Wah(aged about 9) and his parents, his god father (Keung) with his daughter (aged about 5) planned to smuggle some valuable items and information into Thailand. Wah's father, Keung and Leung were the closest of friends, just like blood brothers, all 3 of them were C.I.A. agents. Keung left for Thailand before the others to plan the operation. Leung ganged up with some bandits and forced Wah's father to surrender the confidential information. Wah, hidden in the dark, saw his parents being killed. 20 years later, Wah became an officer in the Thai Air Force. He couldn't take his mind off the revenge. Leung became a successful business man. He was in Thailand to launch a major business project. Ignoring Keung's advise, Wah and Roy slipped into Leung's hotel to try to assassinate him..(n)

programme.title: 標錯參
programme.desc: Sammo and Kenny are lowly employees of a jewelry shop. Sammo too often is the target of abuse from the manageress. One day the two are sent to show the diamonds to a sheik. They are robbed on their way to the bank. One by one they are being accused to be in collusion with the robbers. That makes Sammo very angry. To get even, he plans to kidnap the manageress. Kenny somehow learns of the plot. Sammo gets the wrong woman, Joel. Before he can say ABC, Kenny comes along and kidnaps Joel from Sammo. Sammo demands a ransom from the shop. Kenny asks Sammo for a ransom. Both of them come up with nothing, of course. Not exactly nothing because when they go back to work, they find Joel has taken over the shop. And she apparently thinks kindly of her kidnapper Sammo..(n)

programme.title: 新上海灘
programme.desc: The Taiwan military officer, Hsu falls into the enemy's ambush, and floats to the Shanghai shore where he is saved by Ting Lik. Lik teams up with Kueng to try to make a fortune and soon they become famous in Shanghai. The Shanghai tycoon Fung try to eliminate other opponents with the help of Hsu and Lik. Later, Hsu discovers Fung is the mastermind of the ambush that killed all his fellow officials..(n)

programme.title: 富貴逼人
programme.desc: News reporter Bill and his wife live in a public housing flat with their 3 daughters. Their dream is to get rich someday. When Lady Luck comes knocking on their door one day and they win the first prize of the local lottery, Mark Six, all hell break loose..(n)

programme.title: 冒險王
programme.desc: “The Scripture With No Words” had been lost for a long time. Everybody was eager to find it, even the ambitious Japanese. Dr. Wai was antiquarian. Having seen the mysterious “Wooden Horse”, lost control and killing people, he quit his job. However, being supported by his friend, Dr. Wai recovered and resumed to his work. He went to Shanghai trying to locate “The Scripture With No Words” and he discovered that it was in the possession of the leader of “Gang of Salt”. And the game begin..(n)

programme.title: 師姐好狠勁: 皇家師姐
programme.desc: Senior Police Inspector Ng is assigned to work with another lady inspector from Scotland Yard, to investigate the murder of an agent from the Commercial Crime Bureau of London, who was killed because of the evidence he has collected against a crime syndicate in Hong Kong. As the duo try to work around each other's polarized cultures and background, they kick and punch their way through the investigation, leading to 2 small time pickpockets Strepsil and Panadol, who had stolen the passport containing the evidence from the agent before he died. As the bumbling pickpockets try to dodge the assassins in hot pursuit, they eventually turn to the lady cops for help against the crime boss..(n)

programme.title: 五虎將之決裂
programme.desc: 5 CID members are good friends and form a cooperative team in difficult cases. But the 'Five Tigers' gets blackmailed by the villain and questioned by ICAC for the missing money..(n)

programme.title: 追鬼七雄
programme.desc: Long ago in China, corpses are supposed to be able to follow orders given by a leader and 'jump' to their respective burial places. However, some drug dealers use this method to smuggle opium. Things are going well until the local aristocrat, Master Miu, murders a singer's husband as he fails in attempting to rape her. He asks the corpse leader to take the body away. Then, one of the members from drug dealers is killed mysteriously. When the drug dealers try to go after the case, they find a strange corpse sucking in a huge snake in an old tower. Many members are killed as they try to get out in time..(n)

programme.title: 刀劍笑
programme.desc: The Three Swordsmen is a non-stop action-thriller set in ancient China, starring Brigitte Lin Ching Hsia and Andy Lau.(n)

It is a trail that leads Chan and his partner, Hung from Hong Kong to Taipei and back to Hong Kong. As the trail gets warmer, Chan begins to suspect that there are internal forces – including Hung – who seem to working against him..(n)

programme.title: Save This Shark 第1季
programme.desc:
3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. 
Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. 
Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. 
A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow.

programme.title: Save This Shark 第1季
programme.desc:
3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. 
Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. 
Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. 
A shark encounter at the J-Bay Open saw Mick Fanning become ‘the guy who punched a shark’. A huge part of saving sharks is convincing people that they need our help and putting aside the fear factor. In Save This Shark, Mick takes this incredible opportunity to go on his ow.(n)

偵探艾迪森 -失蹤的無齒翼龍之謎
programme.desc: When an inflatable Pteranodon goes missing from the roof of Pizzamat, Addison and Alex are on the case to find it.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -資源回收大盜
programme.desc: Addison and her friends are distracted from their mission of making cool costumes for Ayrton Park's version of Comicon when someone or something starts messing with recycling bins all over the neighbourhood.

programme.title: 螺絲釘 -管道
programme.desc: Nolik is kicked out of class for repeatedly calling out on the subject of where tubes and pipes can be found. But once outside of class his keen eye saves the day when he spots a leaking tube in the laboratory.

programme.title: 螺絲釘 -電線
programme.desc: It's a very hot day in the laboratory and the Fixies work together to unravel a messy tangle of cords so they can find a free outlet for Professor Eugenius to plug in his fan and cool off.

programme.title: 螺絲釘 -萬花筒
programme.desc: After Tom Thomas breaks his brand new Christmas ornament, Nolik tries to cheer him up with a kaleidoscope. But Tom Thomas' spirits aren't lifted until all of the Fixie kids join in to create an extraordinary design.

programme.title: 優可 -小小狩獵旅行
programme.desc: When Yoko shrinks the kids to a tiny size, they discover all the amazing wildlife in the park they hadn't noticed before.
programme.category: Adventure, Nature, Enironment, Educational, Animation / nan

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -奇幻的地球寓言
programme.desc: Bumble tells stories about life on Earth, but because she's never been there, she starts to tell big fat lies. Therefore, Sprinter and Leo must help her tell stories that are funny, exciting, and not the least true.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -旋轉木馬
programme.desc: It's carnival day in Hill Town. Leo wants to ride the carousel with Sprinter. But he wants to help Rosa win a teddy at the ball toss stand. Riwahl is convinced that he's much better at tossing than Sprinter. The competition between the two rivals begins.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -木星
programme.desc: Jupiter tries to stop Kit from getting closer but Kit falls into the atmosphere and soon realizes there is nowhere to land. With his last bit of his strength, he manages to enter the Great Red Spot. When he flies back to the orbit, Jupiter strikes him with a bat.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -木星的數顆衛星
programme.desc: Kit finds himself hurt and dirty after falling on Jupiter's moon Ganymede. Unable to fly, he is used as a baseball ball in a match between the moons. On Europa he manages to clean himself in a freezing water geyser and finally quit the game.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -領主與農民
programme.desc: Our humble peasant friend Howler can't wait for his next batch of pretzels! However, in the Middle Ages, the feudal system is ruthless, the lord always helping himself to a share of the peasant's yield. And, quite often, all that's left is a few meager crumbs.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -巴西之旅
programme.desc: When Zoe and Milo argue-Zoe wants to do karate while Milo prefers dancing-Alim suggests combining both. Seeing their hesitation, he takes them to Brazil to meet Joao, their correspondent, who introduces them to capoeira, a 'combat dance' created by enslaved people.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -韓國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Alim are surprised to see Milo holding his breath. Did he eat something spicy? No, he's just trying to beat his apnea record. When Zoe wants to try, Milo claims boys are better. Alim takes them to South Korea, where women dive for pearls, and men stay home.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -泰國之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are playing ping-pong when Alim arrives and they offer him a pink racket. But is pink for girls only? Alim takes them to Thailand, where they meet a boy in a pink shirt and learn that in Thailand, colors of clothing match the days of the week, not gender.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -約旦之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo clash over their school show poster-Zoe colors while Milo writes the title. Alim suggests writing from the right, surprising them. In Jordan, they meet Souria preparing a puppet show and learn to write Arabic... from right to left.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -以蝙蝠之名
programme.desc: When Anne sets up a no-go zone to protect bats who are living in a cabin in the park, Lola doesn't understand why they're allowed in there in the first place! Mily discovers animals also have rights and Pop doesn't miss a beat and starts claiming his rights as well.
programme.category: Adventure, Educational, Self Improvement, Animation / nan

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -我就是這樣
programme.desc: Mily and Penelope meet Maceo's cousin and a great athelete - Olivia. Mily and Penelope are awkward because Olivia is handicapped! Mily is ashamed of her reaction and asks herself what she could have done better and how are we supposed to react to a person's disability.
programme.category: Adventure, Educational, Self Improvement, Animation / nan

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -飛行

programme.desc: “Talk With Claire About Great Bay Area” is a bilingual interview program on Shenzhen TV that focuses on in-depth exploration and research. With a global perspective on the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, it captures cutting-edge trends in economic and trade exchanges, technological innovation, cultural trends, and more between China and the world. Through on-site research and interviews, the program engages in conversations with leaders from government, business, technology, and cultural sectors. It showcases technological achievements, trends in economic and trade exchanges, and mutual learning in civilization exchanges. Since its inception over two years ago, “Talk With Claire About Great Bay Area” has aired more than a hundred episodes of specialized interviews. The program integrates prominent international figures into the Greater Bay Area, where guests draw from their personal experiences living and working in the area or provide professional perspectives o.(n)

programme.title: 詩意中國民謠與詩歌的遠行
programme.desc: The sixth season of 'Poetic China' seamlessly weaves the tapestry of Chinese classical poetry with the adventurous spirit of travel, with music serving as the keystone. In collaboration with esteemed national artists, the series ventures across the breathtaking landscapes of our great nation-mountains and seas alike-to listen to the whispering winds and the lullabies of the ocean's depths. These experiences inspire the creation of healing songs that embody the unique charm, merging the rich legacy of Chinese musical traditions with the distinctive urban identity. The program showcases the contemporary urban healing trend through a timeless melody that resonates across the ages. With the solemn duty to 'communicate the beauty of life through poetry,' the show endeavors to cultivate 'cultural confidence among the Chinese people.' Anchored in the vibrant characteristics of Shenzhen, it forges a new television format that is youthful, avant-garde, and engaging.(n)

六姊妹
programme.sub-title: 第三十三集：家喜慫恿媽媽讓大姐家麗搬出去
programme.desc: 家喜的房子賣給家藝後，開始慫恿着美心快點讓家麗搬出去，以便自己回來住。家麗也明白家喜的意思，開始和建國考慮接下來的打算。家歡終於離開了看守所，方濤和成成為她慶祝，但家歡一直情緒不佳，方濤一直努力安慰家歡.

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會 (四) - 行走十五運
programme.desc: 有人説廣州很「矛盾」——有街邊明火大排檔，也有舉世知名的高級餐廳；有傳統廣繡，也有潮人必到的東山口；有嶺南古建築，也有華南最大CBD。今屆全運會，廣州作為主要賽區之一，亦同時承辦了田徑、跳水等傳統競賽項目，以及攀岩、霹靂舞等新興體育項目，以新舊碰撞，展現羊城獨有魅力。. 廣州土生土長的奧運跳水冠軍陳艾森，與香港跳高運動員鄧伊程，今集會帶大家暢遊廣州：在老店親手製作傳統細蓉雲吞、穿越自宋朝起已是廣州中軸線的北京路、坐上無人駕駛飛行器以嶄新角度飽覽美景。. 陳艾森更會帶大家重返母校廣州體育職業技術學院，一窺孕育中國跳水夢之隊的搖籃.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 柳冕因為一場交通意外變成輪椅人士，幸有親情和音樂這些精神支柱，讓他得以重新振作起來。. 身為唱歌愛好者，兩年前他鼓起勇氣、坐着輪椅登上歌唱比賽舞台，想以身作則鼓勵同路人，結果收穫了知名度，成為推廣殘疾平權的力量。. 身為傷健人士組織主席，他們組織每年都會傾盡心機，舉辦很多活動和探訪，希望殘疾人士不要困在家中，但柳冕發現，原來他只要做自己，做好自己熱愛的事，自然可以吸引其他人走出來。. 同時間，他身為爸爸，兒子漸漸長大，踏入青春期，原本親密的親子關係會否有所改變？. 今集主持成家宏還會和柳冕一同busking，一同享受演出的快樂.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 超能蝴蝶
programme.desc: 蝴蝶與飛蛾，優雅而美麗，在春夏的天空會看見牠們輕飛曼舞。絢爛色彩與優雅舞姿，艷壓所有動物。但美，不是牠們的唯一貢獻。. 透過強力的顯微鏡，科學家在蝶蛾類身上發現了奇妙的寶庫及意想不到的秘密，可以借鏡和應用去幫助世界持續發展。本節目將展開一次探索蝶蛾類構造的納米旅程，從全球多個高科技實驗室到森林深處、薰衣草田，細數多個奇妙品種。. 以標誌性的大藍閃蝶為例，研究人員由牠們閃爍的藍色翅膀，揭示了產生結構色的方法，研發出利用納米結構來控制光線。美國羅徹斯特大學光學研究所的郭春雷教授，一直致力複製蝴蝶翅膀結構。他研發了一種能夠吸收光譜中所有顏色的物料，有機會為可再生能源帶來革命性改變。他並利用蝴蝶翅膀的驚人抗水性，研發出一種不沉的金屬。未來若海平面持續上升，這物料將在建造漂浮城市發揮極大作用。. 從翅膀到觸角，蠶蛾、玻璃翼蝶、袖蝶、帝王斑蝶和菜粉蝶，亦啟發了科學家在許多不同領域的發明，包括能源效率、醫藥手術，甚至檢測有毒物質，以拯救人們免受恐怖分子化學或氣體襲擊的威脅！. 研究人員、生物學家和遺傳學家與我們分享他們的超凡實驗，一眾專家包括物理學及仿生專家塞爾·貝狄亞，以及美國自然歷史博物館的昆蟲學家謝茜嘉韋亞，則解釋了一些蝶蛾類驚人的行為和能力。. 蝴蝶與飛蛾提供了很多微小構造的應用靈感，同時亦警告人類，如未能保護這個不斷創新的自然環境，會面對什麼危機。. Butterflies and moths. Graceful and beautiful, flitting and floating in our spring and summer skies. Their delicate choreographies of dazzling colors are among the most amazing in the animal kingdom. But their beauty is not the only thing they can offer. Through the lenses of powerful microscopes, scientists discover treasures of genius and unexpected secrets that can be adapted and applied to make our world better and more sustainable. This film is a journey into the nano-dimensions of butterflies, from high-tech labs around the world to the deepest forests and lavender fields, encountering amazing butterfly species. Like the iconic Morpho: the study of its iridescent blue wing reveals a way to produce structural color. Its nanostructures have inspired researchers to control light. Chunlei Guo, who is continuously seeking to reproduce butterfly structures, has created a material capable of absorbing all colors of the spectrum, a discovery that might revolutionize the field of renewable energies. He is also working on the amazing hydrophobic properties of the wings in order to create an unsinkable metal; we can immediately imagine how useful it could be for the construction of floating cities if the ocean levels continue to rise. From their wings to their antennae, the blue Morpho, the industrious Silk Moth, the astonishing and transparent Greta Oto, the resistant Heliconius, the enigmatic Monarch and the delicate white Cabbage Butterfly, inspire discoveries in many different fields such as energy efficiency, medicine and surgery or even in detecting toxics in order to save lives against terrorist chemical or gas attacks! . Researchers, biologists and geneticists, share with us their thrilling experiments, while experts – like Serge Berthier, a physicist and biomimicry expert, and Jessica Ware, an entomologist at the American Museum of Natural History – explain some of the butterflies' incredible behaviors and capacities. Butterflies and moths provide lessons about what’s possible on the very smallest scales. But they also warn us about what’s at stake if we fail to protect this endlessly inventive natural environment.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 在七十年代粵語歌崛起之際，盧國沾以深具文學氣質的筆觸，改寫了香港流行曲的軌跡。他既能描繪江湖俠客的豪情萬丈，也擅長訴說平凡市民的憂患心聲。於電視劇主題曲盛行的黃金年代，他的詞句成為一代人的精神根基。當情歌氾濫成潮，他卻逆流而行，堅持書寫反戰、理想與土地的議題，從不放棄文字的重量。他的歌詞如同一面鏡子，映照出香港人的焦慮與驕傲，也映出我們共同走過的歲月。今天，就讓我們透過他的歌詞，穿越時光，細看這位「一代詞人盧國沾」的傳奇人生。. . 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 曾慶宏(電影導演、大學講師). 嘉賓主持：. 朱耀偉(香港大學中文學院教授).

programme.sub-title: 第八集: 決心踏上追兇之路
programme.desc: 當年女受害人的父親趙陽碰見程兵，問為甚麼王大勇仍逍遙法外。潘大海破例讓程兵和趙陽走進了刑警隊的案情分析室。十年的線索資料堆積如山，警員沒有放棄，程兵和趙陽都震驚了。程兵重燃鬥志，決心踏上追兇之路.

programme.title: 三大隊
programme.sub-title: 第九集: 到了西雙版納追尋王大勇
programme.desc: 為追查王大勇下落，程兵去到了靠近察邦的西雙版納，得知了一位叫峰哥的蛇頭。勇哥對王大勇的照片有反應，卻閉口不談。程兵意外捲入藏毒案被當地警方帶走，林穎此時竟然出現，林穎勸告程兵不要私自追兇.

BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集 - 藝術好好玩
programme.desc: BobieLand 第二十二集-藝術好好玩. 編導:區達開. BobieLand 連環出現失蹤事件！花哩碌及 Wheel仔本來約好了小朋友但最後失約，連同昨天失約的甜CC，已經有三位失蹤。與此同時，BobieLand 出現了三幅古怪畫，而畫中人正正就是失蹤的甜CC、花哩碌及 Wheel仔，眾人大感奇怪，到底BobieLand為什麼接二連三發生怪事呢?. 【故事時間】「蒙娜麗莎小姐」. 承接昨日的故事書環節，今集繼續有何雁詩Stephanie為小朋友講故事。蒙娜麗莎小姐離開羅浮宮成為全球關注事件，究竟她最後會有甚麼決定.

programme.title: 六姊妹
programme.sub-title: 第三十四集：家喜哄騙取得媽媽的房子
programme.desc: 家喜發現菜場上有人花錢收方子，剛好也問了美心，但美心沒有告訴家喜實情。家喜跟宏宇抱怨原來美心一直防着自己，醬菜方子這個事留了一手。家喜擔心美心日後又被大姐家麗哄回去，決定先下手為強.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 有說「腸道」是人的第二個大腦，食物與情緒之間原來存在着密切聯繫。本集嘉賓阿Bob擁有「為食」身型，除了分享「不健康飲食習慣」作反面教材，更大談如何「食得開心又健康」。廚師Andy Dark以含有豐富蛋白質的「蝦」作為主題食材，炮製「韓式大蝦米紙煎餃」，但對腸道微生態素有研究的黃秀娟教授卻於席間大談「便便」的價值，究竟會否影響大家食慾？兩位識食專員就繼續肩負尋找食材來源的使命，帶大家看看本地出產的基圍蝦是如何養殖。. 主持：黃婉曼(Icy)、Andy Dark. 嘉賓：林盛斌(Bob)、黃秀娟教授(香港中文大學醫學院内科及藥物治療學系教授/腸胃肝臟科專科醫生).

programme.title: 31看世界 - 花花世界
programme.sub-title: 花花世界: 征服者之謎 Flower Power - The Mysterious Conqueror
programme.desc: 花，挑戰不可能。雖然外表弱不禁風，但花是強悍的戰士。它們的歷史充滿征服地球的戰績。目前，地球所有植物物種之中，有花植物佔了九成。花在生命之樹的哪個位置？何時在地球誕生？為何種類如此繁多？它們擁有什麼戰無不勝的超能力？. 新一代科學家正努力回答這些問題，解決花的不解之謎。從非洲沙漠到阿爾卑斯山的山頭，他們的發現正徹底改變我們對有花植物的起源和數量暴增的了解。. 英國生物學家埃德維·莫瓦，以電子顯微鏡觀察木槿花瓣，發現這種植物擁有一種奇妙的能力，可以操縱光線，是吸引授粉昆蟲的無敵武器。以色列的進化理論家妮勒哈德尼，則利用最先進的技術研究花朵，揭示它們有著意想不到的超能力—感應聲音。. 在蘇黎世植物園和白朗峰，生物學家科里亞.謝斯圖和塞巴斯坦.拉凡爾努力研究花朵為何有著人種類繁多的繽紛色彩和形狀。他們的研究顯示，授粉者和地理分隔對開花植物的種類迅速增加起著重要作用。. 在新喀裡多尼亞和納米比亞，遺傳學家瓦萊麗.寶蒂和弗朗索瓦·帕西帶領團隊，搜索史前植物，希望破解這些植物的基因密碼，揭開有花植物起源的秘密。. 以上種種發現，令科學家可以追溯地球植物生命的奇妙歷史，並解開自然界其中一個最棘手的謎團—花的不解之謎。. Flowers defy the impossible. Under their seemingly fragile appearance, they’re fierce fighters. Their history is that of their dazzling conquest of the planet. Today, they represent 90% of plant species. This utter domination has intrigued scientists for centuries. According to Charles Darwin, “The rapid development of flowering plants is an abominable mystery.” What place do flowers hold in the tree of all living beings? When did they first appear on Earth? How can we explain their prodigious diversification? And what are the superpowers that make them invincible? To answer these question and solve the abominable mystery of flowers, a new generation of scientists is hard at work. From the African deserts to the summits of the Alps, their discoveries are revolutionizing the way we conceive the origin and expansion of flowering plants. In the UK, biologist Edwige Moyroud is observing hibiscus petals under an electronic microscope. Her work has highlighted fascinating powers that allow the plant to manipulate light beams, an unstoppable weapon to attract pollinating insects. In Israel, evolution theoretician Lilach Hadany is studying flowers using state-of-the-art technology in order to reveal an unsuspected superpower: Their capacity to detect sounds. At the Zurich Botanical Garden and in the Mont Blanc massif, biologists Florian Schiestl and Sébastien Lavergne are trying to understand the dizzying diversity of shapes and colors in the floral world. Their research shows the role of pollinators and of geographical isolation in the lightning-fast diversification of flowering plants. In New Caledonia and Namibia, geneticists Valérie Burtet and François Parcy are leading expeditions in search of prehistoric plants. Their hope is that the deciphering of their genetic code will unlock the secret of the origin of flowering plants. Thanks to these discoveries, scientists are now able to retrace the fascinating history of vegetable life on Earth and to solve the abominable mystery of flowers, one of nature’s most tenacious enigmas.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 清水混凝土，鋼筋加水泥，建築師把冰冷的物料建造出硬朗的氣派，演變成粗獷派建築（Brutalism）。這種建築風格在戰後重建時期應運而生，並因其功能至上的設計理念，在世界各地留下了獨特的歷史印記。粗獷派建築的發展與社會需求密切相關，許多建築師透過這種風格來回應城市化與現代化的挑戰。這一集「築」動人的粗獷派將帶領觀眾理解粗獷派建築的魅力！. 主持：. 潘浩倫(建築師). 董正綱(建築師). 阮文韜(英國註冊建築師). 嘉賓主持：. 馬祖輝(建築師).

programme.title: 六姊妹
programme.sub-title: 第三十四集：家喜哄騙取得媽媽的房子
programme.desc: 家喜發現菜場上有人花錢收方子，剛好也問了美心，但美心沒有告訴家喜實情。家喜跟宏宇抱怨原來美心一直防着自己，醬菜方子這個事留了一手。家喜擔心美心日後又被大姐家麗哄回去，決定先下手為強.

programme.title: 迎戰全國運動會 (四) - 行走十五運
programme.desc: 要感受功夫文化底蘊的城市，必然想起佛山。要感受中國籃球的熱血激情，絕對只有東莞。今屆全運會，岭南文化名城佛山將會承辦女子成年足球及籃球賽事，中國職業籃球之城東莞則會承辦五人制男子成年組籃球及舉重項目。. 今集香港足球運動員馬澤純帶大家走進廣東傳統武術發源地佛山：遊覽黃飛鴻的故鄉、探尋葉問詠春的魅力、製作佛山獨有的非物質文化遺產木版年畫，更與足球評述員何輝踏進全運會新建場地德勝體育中心，飽覽金屬幕牆設計的場館震撼。. 在東莞成長的中國籃球運動員肖海亮，將會跟大家分享2018年雅加達亞運會三人籃球奪金之路。節目亦會帶大家走進東莞小鎮石龍，與中國第一位摘得奧運金牌的前中國舉重運動員曾國強暢談，認識全國著名的舉重之鄉.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 有說「腸道」是人的第二個大腦，食物與情緒之間原來存在着密切聯繫。本集嘉賓阿Bob擁有「為食」身型，除了分享「不健康飲食習慣」作反面教材，更大談如何「食得開心又健康」。廚師Andy Dark以含有豐富蛋白質的「蝦」作為主題食材，炮製「韓式大蝦米紙煎餃」，但對腸道微生態素有研究的黃秀娟教授卻於席間大談「便便」的價值，究竟會否影響大家食慾？兩位識食專員就繼續肩負尋找食材來源的使命，帶大家看看本地出產的基圍蝦是如何養殖。. 主持：黃婉曼(Icy)、Andy Dark. 嘉賓：林盛斌(Bob)、黃秀娟教授(香港中文大學醫學院内科及藥物治療學系教授/腸胃肝臟科專科醫生).

programme.title: 31看世界 - 花花世界
programme.sub-title: 花花世界: 征服者之謎 Flower Power - The Mysterious Conqueror
programme.desc: 花，挑戰不可能。雖然外表弱不禁風，但花是強悍的戰士。它們的歷史充滿征服地球的戰績。目前，地球所有植物物種之中，有花植物佔了九成。花在生命之樹的哪個位置？何時在地球誕生？為何種類如此繁多？它們擁有什麼戰無不勝的超能力？. 新一代科學家正努力回答這些問題，解決花的不解之謎。從非洲沙漠到阿爾卑斯山的山頭，他們的發現正徹底改變我們對有花植物的起源和數量暴增的了解。. 英國生物學家埃德維·莫瓦，以電子顯微鏡觀察木槿花瓣，發現這種植物擁有一種奇妙的能力，可以操縱光線，是吸引授粉昆蟲的無敵武器。以色列的進化理論家妮勒哈德尼，則利用最先進的技術研究花朵，揭示它們有著意想不到的超能力—感應聲音。. 在蘇黎世植物園和白朗峰，生物學家科里亞.謝斯圖和塞巴斯坦.拉凡爾努力研究花朵為何有著人種類繁多的繽紛色彩和形狀。他們的研究顯示，授粉者和地理分隔對開花植物的種類迅速增加起著重要作用。. 在新喀裡多尼亞和納米比亞，遺傳學家瓦萊麗.寶蒂和弗朗索瓦·帕西帶領團隊，搜索史前植物，希望破解這些植物的基因密碼，揭開有花植物起源的秘密。. 以上種種發現，令科學家可以追溯地球植物生命的奇妙歷史，並解開自然界其中一個最棘手的謎團—花的不解之謎。. Flowers defy the impossible. Under their seemingly fragile appearance, they’re fierce fighters. Their history is that of their dazzling conquest of the planet. Today, they represent 90% of plant species. This utter domination has intrigued scientists for centuries. According to Charles Darwin, “The rapid development of flowering plants is an abominable mystery.” What place do flowers hold in the tree of all living beings? When did they first appear on Earth? How can we explain their prodigious diversification? And what are the superpowers that make them invincible? To answer these question and solve the abominable mystery of flowers, a new generation of scientists is hard at work. From the African deserts to the summits of the Alps, their discoveries are revolutionizing the way we conceive the origin and expansion of flowering plants. In the UK, biologist Edwige Moyroud is observing hibiscus petals under an electronic microscope. Her work has highlighted fascinating powers that allow the plant to manipulate light beams, an unstoppable weapon to attract pollinating insects. In Israel, evolution theoretician Lilach Hadany is studying flowers using state-of-the-art technology in order to reveal an unsuspected superpower: Their capacity to detect sounds. At the Zurich Botanical Garden and in the Mont Blanc massif, biologists Florian Schiestl and Sébastien Lavergne are trying to understand the dizzying diversity of shapes and colors in the floral world. Their research shows the role of pollinators and of geographical isolation in the lightning-fast diversification of flowering plants. In New Caledonia and Namibia, geneticists Valérie Burtet and François Parcy are leading expeditions in search of prehistoric plants. Their hope is that the deciphering of their genetic code will unlock the secret of the origin of flowering plants. Thanks to these discoveries, scientists are now able to retrace the fascinating history of vegetable life on Earth and to solve the abominable mystery of flowers, one of nature’s most tenacious enigmas.

三大隊
programme.sub-title: 第十集: 石頭堅持要參與程兵的行動
programme.desc: 從西雙版納回來，石頭堅持要參與程兵的行動。潘大海從林穎口中得知程兵要去察邦找人的想法，十分反對，可現實的情況他與程兵一樣瞭解。程兵和石頭不斷收集察邦的資料和黑幫“兄弟聯盟”的活動。拿到護照，一切準備就緒，程兵最後一次去了女兒學校遠遠看上一眼.

programme.title: 三大隊
programme.sub-title: 第十一集: 王大勇在異地的仇家
programme.desc: 程兵和石頭潛入當地黑幫”兄弟聯盟”大本營都，找王大勇的線索，卻遇上勇哥等人展開殊死搏鬥。逃走路途中被另一幫人擄走到一個莊園，見到一位找他們的龐先生，他在找王大勇。王大勇當年逃跑後到了察邦，搶走了龐先生價值千萬的原石，還令到龐先生殘疾.

BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集 - 藝術好好玩
programme.desc: BobieLand 第二十三集-藝術好好玩. 編導:區達開. BobieLand 接二連三發生失蹤事件，而且出現神祕人像畫作，眾人都在細心研究。他們發現三幅畫作都維肖維妙，而且畫中人的視線會跟據觀畫者的角度而改變，得出結論：甜CC、花哩碌及 Wheel仔都被變成畫中人！. 【More More 魔術See】. Magic Kevin 利用名畫來表演魔術，將小朋友的畫作，傳送到世界各地的名畫旁，並且拍照傳回 BobieLand!. 【手作 Easy Job】普普藝術(Pop Art)來自流行文化，其中一位知名的藝術家羅伊•李奇特斯坦(Roy Lichtenstein)，他非常擅長利用漫畫創作不同作品，園長寶欣姐姐帶領大家用普普風格製作自畫像.

programme.title: 六姊妹
programme.sub-title: 第三十五集：小年炒期貨欠下巨債
programme.desc: 李雯哭着前來找家麗建國，原來是小年借高利貸炒期貨，欠下巨債，走投無路之下來向父母借錢，建國家麗被小年的糊塗行為氣的渾身發抖，狠狠教訓了一頓小年。但畢竟是自己親生的孩子，家麗和建國為了孩子到處借錢還債.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 維克托的極限清單
programme.sub-title: 維克托的極限清單 - 第一集：冰潛
programme.desc: Victor躺在病床上，發誓有一天要潛進冰下。 根據研究顯示，置身極端寒冷環境讓身體適應，對個人身心方面作用極大，因此，Victor毫不猶豫跳進冰水中，包括攝氏負110度的冷凍療法、耐力比拼冰粒浴、比里牛斯山脈滑雪場健行⋯ 法國冷凍教練 Jean-François Tual引領他挑戰嚴寒極限。Victor要學習克服苦寒，更要衝破心理障礙，逐一完成挑戰。 他與極地探險家Alban Michon携手展開盧湖有趣感人的冰雪之旅，二人在二千米海拔上面積聚的冰川上挖洞，紮營過夜。經過短暫而難忘的夜晚，Victor邁向夢想終點，探索隱藏冰下的奇妙世界。 雙語廣播： 粵語/法語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年8月21日 星期一晚上10時30分 On his hospital bed, Victor promised himself that one day he would dive under the ice. To prepare himself for this ordeal, he is going to live an icy adventure. Recent studies show that immersion in extreme cold forces the body to adapt and that the physical and psychological effects of this practice are exceptional. That's all it takes for Victor to jump into the water. On the program: cryotherapy at -110°c, resistance contest in a bathtub of ice cubes, hikes in briefs on the ski slopes of the Pyrenees. . His main coach, Jean-François Tual, a disciple of Wim Hof, brings him as close as possible to the cold. Victor will have to learn to overcome his chilliness, but above all to break down the barriers in his head in order to go through with his challenge. A touching, funny and decidedly frosty journey that will lead him to Lac du Lou with polar explorer Alban Michon. It is up there, on this glacier which culminates at more than 2000m of altitude that Victor and Alban will dig a hole in the ice pack and will set up their camp for the night. When they wake up, after a short and unforgettable night, it is time for Victor to go to the end of this dream and to discover the wonderful world that hides under the ice. Bilingual: Cantonese/ French (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.08.21 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 大航海時代的出現，重新發現世界，全球航路開闢。歐洲各國不斷發展新的航運技術，蒸氣、鋼鐵的研發不僅改變了航海，更使帝國主義、軍備競賽的出現，大大改變了世界格局。本集與各位一起探索航運科技如何改變世界。. 主持：. 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授). 謝偉傑(香港中文大學歷史系副教授).
